Package org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.item

Interface IExpressionVariableFacade

All Superinterfaces:
IVariableFacade
All Known Implementing Classes:
ExpressionVariableFacade
public interface IExpressionVariableFacade extends IVariableFacade
Variable facade for variables that are defined by an expression tree, which can contain nested operators, references to other variables, inline constants and parameters. Expressions without parameters evaluate to the value of their root node, expressions with parameters evaluate to an operator. Simple expressions (a single operator with only variable references) are stored as IOperatorVariableFacade instead.
